name: Pterodactyl Panel
notes: The panel only. Set TRUSTED_PROXIES in its .env to this node's address, or it builds http:// links. The expected status is empty because / answers a visitor who is not signed in with a redirect. Each Wings node is a service of its own on 8080, with a WebSocket for the console and Behind Proxy ticked on the node; SFTP on 2022 is not HTTP.
